title: Prediction-based Sign Placement Using QA Sampling: code, data and experiment results

creators.name: Abe, Hiroto
creators.affiliation: Graduate School of Information Sciences, Tohoku University

creators.name: Ohzeki, Masayuki
creators.affiliation: Graduate School of Information Sciences, Tohoku University

description:
Code, observation data and experiment results accompanying the manuscript Prediction-based Sign Placement Using QA Sampling.

The repository contains the QUBO construction for trajectory-level pedestrian-flow reconstruction, the solver implementations (simulated quantum annealing, D-Wave Advantage2 hardware quantum annealing, parallel tempering, and a simulated-annealing proxy sampler), trajectory decoding and flow reconstruction, the validation scripts (leave-one-out cross-validation, hyper-parameter sensitivity, bootstrap confidence intervals, KL/JS divergence, effective-temperature estimation, and the ablation of the transition-preference term), the zone-boundary headcount observations, and the curated results of every experiment reported in the paper.

Licensing: the source code is released under the MIT License; the observation data and experiment results (data/ and experiments/*/results/) are released under CC BY 4.0. See LICENSE and LICENSE-DATA.
